title: Your workers
subtitle: Run your agents on compute you own: a cloud sandbox, your Kubernetes cluster or your own VM. Each worker shows up here with its health and capacity.
empty: No worker of your own yet. Evaluations run on the shared worker until you connect one.

default.label: New evaluations run on
default.hint: An evaluation can still pick another worker when you launch it.

actions.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Heimdall stops it, and its token stops working.

form.title: Connect a worker
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Evaluations pick the worker by this name.
form.secretHint: Kept encrypted. Heimdall only uses it to start and stop this worker.
form.vmHint: Heimdall gives you one command. Run it on an Ubuntu or Debian machine with Docker and at least 20 GB free; the worker installs itself as a service and connects.
form.installHint: It holds this worker's token: copy it now, keep it private. Admins can show it again from the worker's card.
form.startHint: Start it to put it to work. It installs itself on first start, which takes a few minutes.

runloop.blueprintHint: A blueprint with Docker preinstalled starts faster.

fly.appHint: An app you created for workers: fly apps create <name>

kubernetes.manifestHint: It creates a narrow account for Heimdall in the namespace and lets the worker change only its own run namespaces.
kubernetes.kubeconfigHint: Inline certificates and tokens only. A kubeconfig that runs a login plugin is refused.
kubernetes.imageHint: An image with bifrost-bench and your project. Leave empty to use the server's image.
